title: What's New: Excise Taxes Framework (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Introduction and Business Value of Excise Tax Framework
Excise Tax Framework Components and Extensibility
CBM and EPR Options Built on Framework
Excise Journal Functionality and Document Sources

features.name: Excise Tax Framework
features.description: A framework delivered in 2025 release wave 2 that provides the foundation for excise tax calculations and registration. The framework is extensible and can be used for various tax types based on similar sources.
caveats: Specific excise tax calculations are not covered in this release
Framework is extensible but requires custom extensions for some calculations

features.name: Excise Journal
features.description: A journal component where users can enter and calculate excise tax information. Includes excise journal templates and batches for collecting information before registration.

features.name: Excise Tax Registration Transaction Logs
features.description: Transaction logs that capture excise tax registrations once information is posted to the journal. These logs provide an audit trail of all excise tax transactions.

features.name: CBM and EPR Calculations
features.description: Carbon Border Mechanism and Extended Producer Responsibility calculations built on top of the excise tax framework. Introduced as sustainability options in this release.
caveats: Not directly related to excise taxes
Separate session required to learn about CBM and EPR implementation

features.name: Multiple Tax Type Options
features.description: Framework supports multiple tax type options including CBM, EPR, and excises. Users can select the type to determine which fields appear in the journal.

features.name: Purchase and Sales Document Integration
features.description: Excise calculations can be based on either purchase or sales documents depending on the scenario. The framework supports tracking from different document sources.

features.name: Item-based Tax Configuration
features.description: Items serve as the primary configuration point for excise tax calculations. Taxes can be connected to specific unit of measure or other quantity-based values on item cards.

features.name: Extended Configuration Sources
features.description: Beyond items, the framework supports configuring excise taxes through resources, item charges, and fixed assets, depending on country-specific requirements.
caveats: Manual population or custom extensions currently required for some options

features.name: Future Excise Tax Calculation Options
features.description: Framework will support additional excise tax calculation options in future releases beyond CBM and EPR. Users can provide feedback on priority calculations such as plastic tax or sugar tax.
